pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Five Weeks in a Balloon
work.note: Cinco Semanas em um Balão é um romance de Júlio Verne, de 1863, sobre uma viagem de balão sobre a África. Na aula, uma amiga conta um passeio de balão muito mais calmo. Frase da aula: We were flying over fields when the sun came up. A cena desta aula é original; não reproduz a obra.

facts.label: Duas ações no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para a curta: We were flying when the sun came up.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para uma ação em andamento: We were flying. Some cows were eating. Com I, he, she e it use was. Com we, you e they use were.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o fato curto: the sun came up, we saw a bird, we landed. Come vira came, see vira saw e take vira took.

pages.title: A coffee shop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is six o’clock in the morning in Houston. The air is cool and quiet. Finn waits at a coffee shop. Sara comes in with red cheeks. She smiles from ear to ear. Finn asks about her ride.
“Sara, how was your balloon ride?” says Finn. “Great! We were flying over fields when the sun came up.” says Sara. “Were you scared?” says Finn.
